title: LDAR was the most consistent albumin-derived index for urosepsis ICU mortality
summary: In retrospective derivation and external cohorts, LDAR showed the most consistent prognostic performance among six albumin-derived indices. The LASSO-feature MLP had external AUC 0.762 (95% CI 0.687–0.840); SOFA plus logLDAR had AUC 0.782, with no significant difference (DeLong P=0.512). Cohort-definition differences may contribute to performance differences. This is prognostic association and risk stratification, not evidence of clinical benefit or causality.
organization: Guiyang Public Health Clinical Center; Affiliated Hospital of Guizhou Medical University
